# Global Institute & CAD CAM

> Global Institute & CAD CAM is an industry-oriented CAD/CAM and technical training institute in Gamharia, Jamshedpur (Jharkhand, India). It trains Diploma, B.Tech and ITI students and working professionals in AutoCAD, SolidWorks, CATIA, Creo, NX CAD, Fusion 360, CNC/VMC programming and industrial skills, using industry-standard labs and real projects, with interview preparation, resume guidance and placement assistance.

## Key facts
- Name: Global Institute & CAD CAM (Global Institute Cad Cam)
- Location: Gamharia Lal Building, Lakshmi Narayan, Near Jamshedpur, Jharkhand 832108, India
- Area served: Gamharia, Jamshedpur, Adityapur, Jharkhand (also associated centers in Delhi, Pune and Hyderabad)
- Phone: +91 87899 61355, +91 83401 45191
- WhatsApp: +91 87899 61355
- Email: info@globalinstitute.edu.in
- Hours: Monday to Sunday, 8:00 AM – 9:00 PM
- Website: https://globalinstitute.devaanshitsolution.in/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/p/Global-Institute-Cad-Cam-61577704497705/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/global_institute_and_cadcam/

## Software & skills taught
AutoCAD, SolidWorks, CATIA, Creo, NX CAD, Fusion 360; 2D drafting and 3D CAD modeling, mechanical drafting, engineering drawing, sheet metal design, reverse engineering, CNC turning and VMC machining, industrial safety and quality, and office productivity (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).

## Who can join
Diploma, B.Tech and ITI students, plus working professionals seeking practical, job-ready technical skills.

## Student support
Real industrial projects, interview preparation, resume guidance and placement assistance.

## Training programs
- [AutoCAD Fundamentals](https://globalinstitute.devaanshitsolution.in/#/courses/auto-cad-fundamentals) — 2D drafting and 3D modeling with AutoCAD.
- [SolidWorks Professional](https://globalinstitute.devaanshitsolution.in/#/courses/solidworks-professional) — 3D product design, assembly and simulation.
- [CNC Lathe Programming](https://globalinstitute.devaanshitsolution.in/#/courses/cnc-lathe-programming) — CNC turning programming and operation.
- [CNC Milling & VMC](https://globalinstitute.devaanshitsolution.in/#/courses/cnc-milling-vmc) — Vertical machining center programming.
- [Industrial Safety & Quality](https://globalinstitute.devaanshitsolution.in/#/courses/industrial-safety-quality) — Workplace safety and quality management.
- [Office Productivity Suite](https://globalinstitute.devaanshitsolution.in/#/courses/office-productivity-suite) — MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook.
